title: Access support through the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS)
summary: Find out how the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) works and where to get support.
intro:
The National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) is an Australia-wide scheme. It is designed to help participants get the support they need so their skills and independence can improve over time.

To be eligible for the NDIS you must:

NDIS funding is provided directly to the individual.

To find out how the scheme works, who your NSW Local Area Coordinator is, and how to go about applying, visit the NDIS website.
who_can_apply: Must be eligible for the NDIS.
